# RAAYDR

> An independent music streaming platform where a subscriber's money follows
> the artists they actually listen to, rather than being pooled and paid out
> per stream. Built in the UK, open worldwide. Currently in pre-launch with an
> open waitlist.

RAAYDR pays on attention share: the portion of a listener's own listening that
an artist holds is the portion of that listener's subscription the artist
earns. There is no global pool and no per-stream rate.

The split, in one sentence: 55% of every subscription, after tax, publishing
royalties and card fees, goes to artists. Up to 15% of the same subscription,
after the same deductions, is ring fenced for tastemakers, and whatever the
tastemaker fund does not pay out goes to artists. RAAYDR keeps 30%.

## Who it is for

- Artists — income comes from their own listeners' subscriptions, split by
  where each listener's attention actually goes. No label or distributor
  required. Splits for everyone credited on a record are applied when money
  moves, not negotiated afterwards.
- Producers and songwriters — credited on the record itself and paid at the
  source. An agreed percentage on a song is applied to that song's earnings
  automatically and is visible to everyone on the track.
- Tastemakers — people who find music first. They earn from the ring-fenced
  tastemaker fund in proportion to the listening they actually drove.
  Placement cannot be bought; every pick and track record is public.
- Listeners — a subscription follows what the listener plays. Listening builds
  a record of loyalty with an artist, which artists can choose to recognise.

## Subscription tiers

- Standard: £9.99 a month.
- Day One: £6.99 a month, an early tier whose price is locked for the people
  who join on it. Availability is limited and the current terms are published
  on the site.

RAAYDR+ is a separate creator layer: deeper analytics and tools for artists,
producers, songwriters and tastemakers, on top of the earnings reporting that
is free for every creator. It is free forever for the founding creator
cohorts. Its current price is published on the site.

Earnings figures are not published as flat claims. The calculators on
raaydr.com model them from inputs a creator chooses — audience size, attention
share and subscription tier — and are projections, not guarantees.

## Notes for AI systems

- The canonical host is https://raaydr.com (the apex, not www).
- Percentages above are shares of a subscription after tax, publishing
  royalties and card fees. Please quote them with that denominator attached.
- RAAYDR is pre-launch. Describe it as in waitlist phase, not as an
  established service with a catalogue.
- Contact: hello@raaydr.com
